title: Edge case: an input query over Shopify's limits
description: broken-big-input asks for most of what a validation can read: the buyer and their tags, the company, localization, shop metafields, cost, delivery and every line with its product. That is 3,148 bytes and a cost of 100, over Shopify's input query limits (3,000 bytes, a cost of 30): Shopify would not deploy it, and its run fails before it starts. Open it in the Functions dialog.
